Piko-piko-piin!!<LF>You may already be aware, but this is important,<LF>so let me explain attributes, types, roles, and aptitudes!
Every character has an attribute,<LF>and attributes have advantages and disadvantages!
First, try pressing the Attribute button!
To see which attributes a character is strong against,<LF>check this table and build your formation accordingly!
Characters are divided into # types,<LF>and each type has its own tendencies!
Physical types tend to fill attacker and tank roles,<LF>and many of them excel in the vanguard!
EN types often fill EN attacker, support, and control roles,<LF>and many of them excel in the rearguard!
Agile types, unlike EN types,<LF>more often fill physical attacker, support, and control roles,<LF>and many excel as both vanguard and rearguard!
<size=40>Physical Type</size><LF>Often fills physical attacker and tank roles,<LF>and tends to have position aptitude for the vanguard.
<size=40>EN Type</size><LF>Often fills EN attacker, support,<LF>and control roles,<LF>and tends to have position aptitude for the rearguard.
<size=40>Agile Type</size><LF>Often fills physical attacker and support,<LF>and control roles,<LF>and tends to have position aptitude for both vanguard and rearguard.
Type is only a tendency, so<LF>let's check the actual roles and position aptitudes!
Character roles are divided into # roles,<LF>and each one has its own part to play!
Physical attackers excel at dealing damage with physical attacks!<LF>They say attack is the best defence, so work them into your formation!
EN attackers excel at dealing damage with EN attacks!<LF>Pairing them with a physical attacker in front and rear<LF>for a damage-focused setup is another good plan!!
Next, tanks have lots of HP and high defence,<LF>so they excel at holding the vanguard and shielding allies from enemy attacks!<LF>You always want one in your formation.
Supports excel at buffing and healing allies,<LF>so pick the support your formation needs!
Controls, on the other hand, inflict status ailments and interference on enemies!<LF>They are perfect for technical fights that raw damage cannot break through!
<size=40>Physical Attacker</size><LF>A role specialising in physical attacks and dealing damage
<size=40>EN Attacker</size><LF>A role specialising in EN attacks and dealing damage
<size=40>Tank</size><LF>A role specialising in taking hits with high durability and protecting allies
<size=40>Support</size><LF>A role specialising in assisting allies with buffs and healing
<size=40>Control</size><LF>A role specialising in hindering enemies with status ailments and interference
That was a lot at once, but you can check it any time,<LF>so come back whenever you forget!
Some characters have positions they are bad at,<LF>so be a little careful when deciding placements in your formation!
Placing a character in a column they are bad at lowers their stats a little.<LF>It is only #%, so it is not a dramatic drop,<LF>but everyone has strengths and weaknesses, so keep it in mind!
That covers attributes, types, roles, and aptitudes!<LF>Build your characters well and aim for the strongest unit!<LF>And leave anything else to me!

Piko-piko-n! Master! Are you ready!?<LF>To "defeat" Izanami, we would like to strike the "Yatagarasu" itself, but...
First, we need to stop the attacks of the "Amatsu Mikaboshi" that are raiding the mass driver!<LF>Which "Amatsu Mikaboshi" to target is up to you, Master!
Note that while fighting a chosen "Amatsu Mikaboshi" you cannot fight the others!<LF>Once a set period passes and the phase changes, you will be able to fight the others again!
Now then, Master! In order to defeat Izanami...<LF>let's take on the "Amatsu Mikaboshi"!
This event contains spoilers up to Chapter #.<LF>Are you sure you want to join the event?
<line-height=2.000em>We... were created from the very start as disposable,<LF>existing just to gather resources...?
<line-height=2.000em>Earth? Descendants of humanity? Amatsukaze...?<LF>You mean we were born to be exploited by those incomprehensible people!?
<line-height=2.000em>Surprisingly, just like Kotoha,<LF>Rami - the one most likely to lose her temper - said it in a calm voice.
<line-height=2.000em>But you know, even if someone we have never met decides our future for us,<LF>we have no obligation to obey them. We just ignore it.
<line-height=2.000em>Honestly, my answer is "so what". Whatever happened long before we were born<LF>doesn't change who Rami and the others are now.
<line-height=2.000em>Rami and the others decide for Rami and the others! What we do from now on, we decide<LF>among ourselves! Nobody else interfere! That's all! ...or something like that?
<line-height=2.000em>...Hmph. I suppose you're right. I never thought I would hear that<LF>from a brat like you.
<line-height=2.000em>Huh!? Who are you calling a brat, huh!? I won't take that from<noparse>Andrew</noparse>'s<LF>tail-wagging, totally-smitten, pride-wrecked mutt of a dog!
<line-height=2.000em>Pride-wrecked mutt of a dog!? Who is a dog!?<LF>You are starting to annoy me more than Izanami!
<line-height=2.000em>What a coincidence! Rami finds you more annoying than that damn AI too!<LF>How about we settle this before we take down Izanami!? Huh!?
<line-height=2.000em>But really, Rami is right. It is shocking,<LF>but I have not the slightest intention of letting Izanami have her way.
<line-height=2.000em>Right. I have no intention of giving it to anyone. Izanami's goal is not<LF>the same as ours. Why we were created does not matter.
<line-height=2.000em>I think so too. But precisely for that reason, Izanami, who toys with our lives<LF>like a tool, is still someone we have to stop.
<line-height=2.000em>That is right. I feel as though my resolve to settle things with Izanami<LF>has grown firmer.
<line-height=2.000em>Or rather, "to gather resources" aside,<LF>this story has become far too grand for me to follow...
<line-height=2.000em>So everything we learned at the Academy about evolution is a lie,<LF>and all our ancestors were created by Izanami?
<line-height=2.000em>Everyone's ancestors come from the frozen fertilised eggs and the gene data<LF>library that were loaded onto the Amatsukaze.
<line-height=2.000em>Even an emigration ship has a limit to how many people it can carry. ...After settlement, if only the crew<LF>had children, genetic diversity could have run short.
<line-height=2.000em>...To make up for that, the Amatsukaze carried something<LF>called a "Human Genetic Asset Library".
<line-height=2.000em>...The moment I heard about that "ship" from Pico, everything came back.<LF>I still cannot take it in as my own experience, though...
<line-height=2.000em>I was... a crew member of the interstellar emigration ship "Amatsukaze".
<line-height=2.000em>I came from somewhere other than Zartum Island,<LF>together with Izanami and many of my comrades.
<line-height=2.000em>But honestly, remembering it was not something to be glad about.<LF>Even though I finally remembered. Because--
<line-height=2.000em>Wait. So <noparse>Andrew</noparse> is from<LF>that vessel...? From what you say, it is from 10,000 years ago, is it not?
<line-height=2.000em>Yes, yes! So that means <noparse>Andrew</noparse> is,<LF>seriously, an unbelievable age...!
<line-height=2.000em>There is a technology called cold sleep that puts a body into a frozen sleep,<LF>preserving it long-term while preventing ageing.
<line-height=2.000em>...Hearing that, one thing fell into place for me.<LF>When I admitted him to the Academy, I investigated him thoroughly.
<line-height=2.000em>So there is no doubt that we share a common ancestor -<LF>the "Earthlings" who were driven from their homeland.
<line-height=2.000em>...But there was exactly one decisive difference<LF>between <noparse>Andrew</noparse> and the rest of us.
<line-height=2.000em>The carbon atoms that make up the body - their radioactive isotope ratio.<LF>It was completely different.
<line-height=2.000em>............Hey, Harry. Do you understand what they are talking about...?<LF>Amatsukaze...? What is that?
<line-height=2.000em>No, is this not the kind of thing that needs explaining from the very beginning...<LF>Well, I am about half lost myself, though.
<line-height=2.000em>The carbon isotope ratio is passed down through the food chain in an ecosystem.<LF>So if you grow up on Zartum Island, the value stays within a set range.
<line-height=2.000em>That is why, for example, the brat over there and I live lives<LF>that are completely different, yet our numbers do not differ much.
<line-height=2.000em>Um, in short... an ecosystem's carbon isotope ratio,<LF>in the end, reflects the carbon isotope ratio contained in the land itself.
<line-height=2.000em>But only <noparse>Andrew</noparse>,<LF>that value was clearly outside our range.
<line-height=2.000em>We know no world but Zartum Island. And in a place like that,<LF>we found a person who seemed to have lived in an environment unlike the island.
<line-height=2.000em>That is why Kotoha and I thought this:<LF>that this person came from "outside this world"--
<line-height=2.000em>So... the genes are the same, but the material forming your body is different.<LF>The environment you were born and raised in really was different from here.
<line-height=2.000em>It does not feel real, somehow... Even when we first met,<LF>I could not tell at all that you were "different" from us.
<line-height=2.000em>"Different" or not, it is only the environment you were raised in.<LF>As living beings we are the same. It is no wonder you could not tell.
<line-height=2.000em>There is one thing that bothers me. When we first met,<LF><noparse>Andrew</noparse> said something.
<line-height=2.000em>In the end, did that mean Izanami taking the resources will leave our society<LF>unable to function... was that the right reading?
<line-height=2.000em>Because it is true that resource depletion from Izanami's plundering<LF>would lead to the extreme decline of Zartum civilisation.
<line-height=2.000em>Humanity surely cannot keep its current numbers and will decline.<LF>A very harsh, sad future awaits.
<line-height=2.000em>But, to take it to an extreme... if civilisation fell back to the Stone Age,<LF>I think mere survival might still be possible.
<line-height=2.000em>Yes. Though it is also possible that <noparse>Andrew</noparse><LF>deliberately chose that wording...
<line-height=2.000em>Maybe it is related to the "calamity"<LF>Pico mentioned earlier... was that it?
<line-height=2.000em>"I do not recommend my destruction."<LF>"Rather, it would become irreversible for this world," she said.
<line-height=2.000em>Oh my... does that mean there is a crisis in the world we have not noticed yet--<LF>not just resource depletion, but something else as well?
<line-height=2.000em>"Disposable"--does that mean it is not simply about civilisation collapsing,<LF>but contains something even worse?
<line-height=2.000em>If <noparse>Andrew</noparse> has his memories back,<LF>surely he knows something...?
<line-height=2.000em><noparse>Andrew</noparse>...<LF>When the Amatsukaze is repaired, what will become of us?
<line-height=2.000em>To start with, the words I said before, the "calamity",<LF>and Izanami's "irreversible thing" are all separate matters.
<line-height=2.000em>Sorry for the confusion, everyone.<LF>First, "defeating" Izanami means--
